edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s at max — his whole kill window. Survive it, then punish the body he snaps back to; early ranks give you a 15-plus-second lane where he has no engage. - Your E is 15s: chip damage never gets it. - His R is 120/100/80 — same clock as yours, so trade ult for ult and win the reset.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him for 14s at a time and eats your opening burst — poke the shield off first, then stun the dash while he is actually killable. Committing into a fresh W is half a combo wasted.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Your R is point-and-click and his R is 120/100/80 — when he commits Fate Sealed and misses, that is the whole window. Holding yours past it is how the all-in he keeps threatening finally lands.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His third Mortal Steel dashes a fixed line — QE the flight path itself, not the landing, and his knock-up turns into your stun.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Hoarding the 120s ult through Soul Unbound is the classic loss — when the spirit snaps back to a low body, that body is the kill R buys.
